# Citation

The 3,000 Rice Genomes Project (rice). *The 3,000 rice genomes project*. GigaScience. DOI: 10.1186/2047-217X-3-8. Source: [https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4035669/](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4035669/).

# One-Sentence Summary

Describes the 3,000 Rice Genomes Project, a broad rice diversity resource for genomic analyses.

# Scope for simitall

Use as the data-source reference for rice panel workflows. A simitall recipe should require a locally downloaded, documented subset rather than assume remote access or distribute the full project data.

# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- Diversity panels enable realistic founder differences and population structure.
- Subset choices can strongly change allele spectra and LD.
- Sample origin and subgroup labels are scientifically relevant metadata.

# Inputs to Specify

- Panel genotype or haplotype data
- Reference build and chromosome selection
- Subpopulation and quality-control filters

# Expected Outputs

- Panel subset
- Sample and subgroup metadata
- Filtering provenance

# Limitations and Guardrails

- A resource-scale panel is not a ready-to-run package example.
- Do not mix coordinate systems or reference assemblies across inputs.

# Questions This Record Can Ground

- How should a 3K rice panel be subset for a simulation?
- Which provenance fields should accompany an empirical haplotype panel?
